name: Brew

categories.label: Brewed potions (in hand + drunk)
categories.labelVi: Thuốc đã pha (cầm tay + đã uống)
categories.hint: Sum the VP printed on every potion you brewed, drunk or not. Reserved potions you did not brew score 0.

categories.label: Claimed Forests
categories.hint: Sum the VP printed on all Forest cards you claimed.

categories.label: Creatures released into a matching Forest
categories.labelVi: Sinh vật đặt vào Rừng khớp mùa
categories.hint: 3 VP each. Each claimed Forest takes one creature matching any of its seasons.

categories.label: VP tokens collected
categories.hint: Total value of VP tokens gained during the game (from creature powers etc.).

categories.label: Leftover ingredient tokens (incl. Energy Berries)
categories.labelVi: Nguyên liệu còn dư (gồm cả Berry)
categories.hint: Enter the number of tokens; 1 VP per full 3 tokens.

tiebreakers.description: Most leftover ingredient tokens (including Energy Berries).
If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: end-game-categories. Game ends after the 4th round (when no new row of Forests can be dealt). Character powers/creature powers that grant VP tokens are captured via the VP tokens field. Unlimited token supply per rulebook note.

sources.title: Brew rulebook (1j1ju mirror of official rules)
sources.section: p.15 Final Scoring, Winning the Game, Tiebreaker; p.6 Check for Game End
